newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOT-Mitsubishi provides support to Nippon Trust.
newsitem.headline: BOT-Mitsubishi provides support to Nippon Trust.

text.p: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd said on Monday it had provided 42.32 billion yen to support its unit Nippon Trust Bank Ltd, which had forgiven a similar amount in loans it had extended to a housing loan company.
The loans were those extended to Juso Inc, Nippon Trust said in a statement.
Nippon Trust said the loan forgiveness would not have an impact on its earnings in the business year to March 31, 1997.
It would include the financial support from Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi in its extraordinary profit in the six months ended on Monday, Nippon Trust said.
